enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Remains still. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Moves arm under pillow. Shifts legs. Breathes deeply. Turns onto back. Remains motionless. Continues sleeping.
Opens eyes. Sits up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Steps into shower. Turns on shower. Washes body. Turns off shower. Dries body with towel. Brushes teeth. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Greets Member 1. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and milk. Picks up frying pan. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into pan. Toasts bread. Sets table. Sits down. Eats breakfast. Talks with Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Selects shirt and trousers. Removes pajamas. Puts on shirt. Buttons shirt. Puts on trousers. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Picks up phone. Picks up bag. Walks out.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Swipes transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Takes out phone. Checks emails. Puts phone away. Gets off bus. Walks to office building. Enters building. Greets security guard. Walks to elevator. Presses button. Enters elevator. Presses floor number. Exits elevator. Walks to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as arts administrator, handling office tasks and meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Makes phone calls. Attends meeting. Takes notes. Discusses project. Returns to desk. Types document. Prints document. Files papers. Talks to colleague. Drinks water. Stands up. Stretches. Sits down. Continues working.

Walks to cafeteria. Picks up tray. Selects sandwich. Picks up apple. Pays for food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats sandwich. Bites apple. Drinks water. Checks phone. Talks to coworker. Finishes lunch. Clears tray. Throws trash. Walks outside. Walks back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as arts administrator, continuing office tasks and meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Returns to desk. Opens laptop. Checks calendar. Attends meeting. Presents ideas. Listens to feedback. Takes notes. Returns to desk. Edits document. Sends emails. Makes calls. Organizes files. Meets with artist. Discusses exhibition. Updates schedule. Prepares report. Prints copies. Collates documents. Staples papers. Places in folder.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Swipes card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Reads news. Gets off bus. Walks home. Enters house. Removes shoes. Greets Member 1.

Walks to kitchen. Puts on apron. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Washes vegetables. Cuts vegetables. Turns on induction cooker. Pours oil into pan. Adds vegetables. Stirs with spatula. Sets table. Serves food.

Sits at table. Picks up fork. Eats food. Chews. Drinks water. Talks with Member 1. Cuts food with knife. Finishes meal. Picks up plate. Rinses plate. Places plate in dishwasher. Wipes mouth with napkin.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Browses channels. Selects show. Puts remote down. Watches TV. Talks with Member 1. Adjusts sitting position. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts phone down. Continues watching TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Gets glass of water. Returns to sofa. Sits down. Continues watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on freelance illustration projects using computer and monitor
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom 2. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Turns on computer. Turns on monitor. Opens illustration software. Loads project file. Picks up stylus. Draws sketch. Adjusts colors. Zooms in. Zooms out. Saves file. Stands up. Stretches. Sits down. Continues drawing. Exports final image. Turns off computer. Turns off monitor. Turns off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Turns on tap. Washes face. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Uses toilet. Flushes. Washes hands. Dries hands. Takes off clothes. Steps into shower. Turns on shower. Washes body. Turns off shower. Dries body with towel. Puts on pajamas. Turns off light. Walks out.
Walks to bedroom 2. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket. Closes eyes. Breathes deeply. Turns to side. Remains still. Falls asleep.
